description: This Java source file defines the TrackingCodeEvents class, which contains static methods for handling tracking code logic within a web application, including URL parameter checks, cookie management, event processing, and order tracking related to marketing tracking codes.

classes.name: TrackingCodeEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for managing tracking codes, cookies, and related events for marketing tracking within a web application.

methods.name: checkTrackingCodeUrlParam
methods.description: Checks for 'autoTrackingCode' or 'atc' URL parameters, retrieves or logs tracking code, and processes it if found.

methods.name: checkPartnerTrackingCodeUrlParam
methods.description: Handles 'ptc' or 'dtc' URL parameters for partner-managed tracking codes, creating default entries when necessary.

methods.name: processTrackingCode
methods.description: Associates the tracking code with the current visit, sets cookies, session attributes, and handles redirection based on tracking code configuration.

methods.name: checkTrackingCodeCookies
methods.description: Inspects cookies for tracking codes, and associates them with the current visit.

methods.name: checkAccessTrackingCode
methods.description: Validates an access tracking code from URL or cookies, ensuring it is active and of the correct type.

methods.name: removeAccesTrackingCodeCookie
methods.description: Deletes access tracking code cookies from the request.

methods.name: makeTrackingCodeOrders
methods.description: Creates tracking code order entities based on current cookies for inclusion in an order.
